content.tracking: Always include FedEx tracking link in the ClickUp comment when a shipment is created.

tools.Master Shipping: Used to check shipping history and tracking.
tools.ClickUp: Task management for follow‑up and tracking.
tools.Zendesk: Ticket management and macros for deadlines.

daily_follow_up.frequency: Every calendar day (Monday–Friday, unless otherwise directed)
daily_follow_up.update_clickup: After completing both actions, change Due Date to TOMORROW. Failure to do so will cause the task to disappear from the next day's pending list and will be flagged as an error.

statuses.INTERNAL_WAITING: Waiting for internal department (shipping, compensation, accounting).

deadline_and_closure.deadline_trigger: After 4 days of no customer response

lost_lead.example_comment: Closed as LOST LEAD. Deadline sent on [date]. Customer did not respond after [X] previous contact attempts. If customer re‑engages, ticket will be reopened.

closure_rules.customer_confirmation: Never close a case until the customer explicitly confirms receipt (by email or phone) of product, instructions, or refund. FedEx signature alone is NOT sufficient.
closure_rules.documentation: All confirmations must be recorded as a comment in ClickUp BEFORE closing.
closure_rules.resolution_field: Never leave the resolution field empty. For no‑response cases, use 'LOST LEAD'.
